**Your Intelligent Companion for a Smarter Future.**

Discover the next generation of robotics with the G1 Basic Edition, a bipedal humanoid robot designed for interactive experiences, entertainment and robotics exploration. Combining a distinctive human-inspired design with a durable metal construction, the G1 brings futuristic technology closer to everyday life.

Whether you're a technology enthusiast, educator, business owner or robotics collector, the G1 offers an exciting opportunity to explore the possibilities of intelligent machines.

## KEY FEATURES

**Humanoid Bipedal Design**
A human-inspired robotic form that makes the G1 a distinctive addition to modern homes, technology studios, educational environments and professional demonstrations.

**AI Interaction Potential**
Designed for interactive robotics applications. Available conversational, voice-control and AI functions depend on the installed software and supported configuration.

**A Companion for Everyday Inspiration**
Imagine exploring recipes, learning new things, planning daily activities or enjoying technology-assisted conversations with a robotic companion. Compatible AI software may enable additional interactive experiences. Physical assistance and autonomous household tasks are not confirmed standard features.

**Education & Robotics Exploration**
Discover humanoid robotics, intelligent systems and human-machine interaction. An exciting platform for technology enthusiasts and educational demonstrations, subject to supported control and programming capabilities.

**Entertainment & Demonstrations**
Bring futuristic technology to exhibitions, showrooms, presentations or your personal collection. The G1's humanoid design makes it a natural conversation starter.

**Durable Metal Construction**
Built with a metal structure designed for durability. The robot weighs approximately 35 kg according to the supplier's specifications.

The standard listing specifies the G1 Basic Edition in its default packaging, without a protective bracket. Battery inclusion varies by configuration. Please confirm the exact package contents, charger, controller, software, accessories and battery configuration before ordering.

AI capabilities, voice interaction, autonomous movement, programming interfaces and compatibility with external software depend on the specific hardware and software configuration. These functions should be confirmed before purchase.

Actual battery performance may vary depending on usage. Shipping costs, delivery times and applicable import charges must be confirmed for your destination. The supplier lists an eight-month warranty; please confirm the applicable terms before ordering.

## WHY CHOOSE SPACE AGE ROBOTICS?

At Space Age Robotics, we believe the future of technology should be exciting, accessible and inspiring. We bring innovative robotics and intelligent systems closer to people who want to discover what tomorrow can offer.

Whether you're exploring robotics for personal interest, education, business or entertainment, the G1 Basic Edition is an opportunity to experience the fascinating world of humanoid machines.

# SPIDERPI AI – INTELLIGENT SIX-LEGGED ROBOT

**Explore Robotics from a Whole New Perspective.**

Meet SpiderPi AI, a six-legged robotic platform designed for exploring intelligent robotics, computer vision and programmable movement. Inspired by the agility of spiders, this compact robot brings advanced robotics concepts into an exciting hands-on platform for developers, technology enthusiasts and educational projects.

Whether you're experimenting with AI, exploring robotic locomotion or building your own intelligent systems, SpiderPi AI offers an engaging way to discover the future of autonomous robotics.

## KEY FEATURES

**Six-Legged Robotic Design**
Explore multi-legged locomotion with a spider-inspired design. Six-legged robotics offers an exciting introduction to coordinated movement, balance and robotic control.

**AI & Computer Vision Potential**
Explore the possibilities of visual recognition, object tracking and camera-based robotics. Available vision functions depend on the included camera, software, processing hardware and supported configuration.

**Raspberry Pi & ROS Ecosystem**
The product listing references Raspberry Pi 5 and ROS-based robotics. Compatible configurations can provide a flexible foundation for robotics programming, experimentation and software development. Confirm the exact onboard computer and ROS version before ordering.

**Intelligent Robotics Development**
An exciting platform for exploring robotic control, sensor integration, computer vision and AI-assisted applications. Supported development options depend on the supplied electronic modules and software.

**Built for Learning & Experimentation**
Ideal for robotics enthusiasts, students, developers and technology labs interested in understanding how intelligent machines perceive and interact with their environment.

**Compact & Versatile Platform**
With a listed shipping weight of approximately 4.5 kg, SpiderPi AI is a compact robotics platform suitable for a range of development and demonstration environments.

## WHAT CAN YOU EXPLORE WITH SPIDERPI AI?

**Computer Vision Projects**
Experiment with camera-based perception and visual processing using compatible hardware and software.

**Robotics Programming**
Explore robotic movement, control systems and ROS-based development, depending on the supplied software and interfaces.

**AI & Automation Experiments**
Use the platform as a starting point for investigating how intelligent software can interact with physical robotic systems.

**Education & Research**
Discover the fundamentals of robotics, sensors, locomotion and intelligent machine design through practical experimentation.

**Your Own Robotics Projects**
For developers and makers, a programmable robotic platform can provide a foundation for testing ideas, exploring integrations and developing new applications within the robot's supported capabilities.

## WHAT'S INCLUDED?

The exact package contents have not been fully specified in the available supplier information. Please confirm whether the selected version includes the Raspberry Pi 5, camera, six-legged robot assembly, controller, battery, charger, sensors, electronic modules, software and required accessories before ordering.

Advertised AI, visual recognition, 3D scanning and autonomous functions depend on the actual hardware, software and configuration supplied. Not all features mentioned in the product title are necessarily included or preconfigured.

Raspberry Pi and ROS compatibility should be verified for the exact model. Additional programming, installation or configuration may be required. Confirm supported operating systems, available development interfaces and included documentation before purchase.

## WHY CHOOSE SPACE AGE ROBOTICS?
